description: This file defines the XmlParser class which implements standard XML parsing for REST-XML and Query protocols within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to parse various XML shapes such as structures, lists, maps, and primitive types, converting XML elements to corresponding PHP data structures.

classes.name: XmlParser
classes.description: A class that implements the XML parsing logic for AWS API responses, handling different shape types and converting XML into PHP data structures.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Entry point for parsing a structure shape using an XML element.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches XML parsing to specific methods based on shape type.

methods.name: parse_structure
methods.description: Parses an XML structure shape into an associative array.

methods.name: memberKey
methods.description: Determines the XML node name for a shape member, considering locationName and flattened list configurations.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses an XML list shape into a PHP array.

methods.name: parse_map
methods.description: Parses an XML map shape into a PHP associative array.

methods.name: parse_blob
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded binary blob from XML.

methods.name: parse_float
methods.description: Converts XML element text to a float.

methods.name: parse_integer
methods.description: Converts XML element text to an integer.

methods.name: parse_boolean
methods.description: Converts XML element text to a boolean.

methods.name: parse_timestamp
methods.description: Converts string or numeric XML value to a DateTimeResult object, handling timestamp parsing.

methods.name: parse_xml_attribute
methods.description: Extracts attribute values from an XML element, considering namespace and prefix.
